title: Dialectica Sponsors Inaugural Panathēnea 2025 Innovation Festival in Athens
summary: Dialectica sponsored Panathēnea 2025, a three-day innovation festival in Athens attracting 3,100+ attendees from 44 countries. CEO George Tsarouchas joined a founders panel. The festival featured 100+ international speakers including Canva CEO Melanie Perkins and Google Maps co-founder Lars Rasmussen.
whyItMatters: Community sponsorship reflects Dialectica's Greek heritage and local engagement.
